dimensions.label: Bilingual Code-Switch Intelligibility (bn_BD <-> en_US)
dimensions.criteria: Evaluates smooth intra-sentential switching between Bengali grammar and embedded English domain terms without sudden voice-timbre resets.

dimensions.label: Prosody & Natural Breath-Pause Cadence
dimensions.criteria: Checks authentic conversational breath gaps (200-450 ms) and natural pitch declination rather than compressed zero-gap stitching.

dimensions.label: Acoustic Timing & Cut-Boundary Integrity
dimensions.criteria: Verifies zero clipped initial/final plosives, stable syllable pacing, and clean turn-boundary endings.

dimensions.label: Bengali Phonological & Diacritic Fidelity
dimensions.criteria: Audits aspirated vs. unaspirated stops, retroflex articulation, and nasalized vowels in standard and Dhaka conversational registers.

dimensions.label: Register, Affect & Instruction Adherence
dimensions.criteria: Measures whether tone (broadcast, explanatory, calm advisory) matches prompt specification without hallucinated persona drift.

dimensions.label: Spectral Cleanliness & Artifact Freedom
dimensions.criteria: Penalizes metallic vocoder buzz, repeated micro-stutters, or harsh digital gating noise.
